mapper.sql: id, task_id, execution_id, attempt, event_type, old_status, new_status, worker_id, trace_id, operator, detail, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM asts_task_execution_event WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asts_task_execution_event ( id, task_id, execution_id, attempt, event_type, old_status, new_status, worker_id, trace_id, operator, detail, created_at ) VALUES ( #{event.id}, #{event.taskId}, #{event.executionId}, #{event.attempt}, #{event.eventType}, #{event.oldStatus}, #{event.newStatus}, #{event.workerId}, #{event.traceId}, #{event.operator}, #{detailJson}::jsonb, #{event.createdAt} )
